# Scratchwork

> Pen-first notes for university STEM students. Scratchwork checks your math step by step and builds practice tests, lessons and flashcards from your own notes and class material. Invite-only beta for Android and Windows.

Scratchwork is a notes app for university STEM students who write by hand. It runs on Android tablets and phones and on Windows; iOS is planned. It is an invite-only beta made by one person. No prices are set yet. Request an invite by emailing ntblair417+scratchwork@gmail.com.

What it does: handwritten notebooks with a pen; a Math card that checks each step and points to the first wrong one; practice tests, step-by-step lessons, flashcards and formula sheets built from your own notes and class material; a Mistakes Log. It can read Blackboard, WebAssign and WeBWorK with your own sign-in and never submits anything. Scratchwork is not affiliated with Blackboard, WebAssign, WeBWorK or any school.
